234.name: Fenrir's Tusk
234.skillDesc1: On hit, has a 85% chance to inflict Bleed on enemies, dealing 1320% (2120)% weapon's attack damage per second for 3 seconds.
234.skillDesc2: Has 20% (30)% chance to dodge up to 100 (150) damage when attacking with this weapon.

766.name: Fenrir: Godslayer
766.skillDesc1: On hit, has a 100% chance to inflict Bleed on enemies, dealing 3000% (4000%) weapon's attack damage per second for 5 seconds. If you holding this weapon and an enemy on the field is in bleeding state, increases Movement Speed by 30%.
766.skillDesc2: When hitting an enemies in bleeding state, increases this weapon's Critical Chance by 10% and Critical Damage by 20% for 3 seconds. Stacks up to 10 times. At maximum stacks, damage is counted as a Back Attack and additionally deals 150% (200%) of the remaining Bleed damage.

1437.name: Kos, the Nameless Daughter
1437.skillDesc3: Each enemy defeat within a 300-radius of the character increases this pet skill's Damage multiplier by 30(60)%, up to a maximum increase of 600%.
1437.petAtkDesc: Each enemy defeat within a 300-radius of the character will increases this pet's damage dealt by 30(60)%, up to 600%.
1437.petSkillDesc: Blast an explosion, dealing 300(600)% damage.
1437.petUnlockedDesc: Triggers an explosion, dealing 300(600)% damage, and increases damage dealt by player by 12(24)% based on this pet skill level for 10(15) seconds.
1437.petPassiveDesc: While the character's HP drops below 80(100)%, this pet skill's cooldown is decreased by 50%.

3267.name: Romantic Journey
3267.skillDesc1: Upon deploy, summons a UFO that flies and shines beams randomly across the field. Enemies hit by the beam have a 100% chance to become sheep for 2(2.5) seconds. Characters hit by the beam gain 150(200)% All Damage and 20% (30)% Movement Speed for 8 (10) seconds.
3267.skillDesc2: When the UFO's flight duration on field ends, it crashes and explodes, dealing 4000 (6500) damage to targets within a 400-yard radius. Deals 100% more damage to enemies that have become sheep.

3268.name: Romantic Journey

3268.skillDesc2: When the UFO's flight duration on field ends, it crashes and explodes, dealing 5,000 (7,500) damage to targets within a 400-yard radius. Deals 100% more damage to enemies that have become sheep.

4604.name: Xilu's Small Wish
4604.skillDesc1: Upon use, increases Movement Speed by 40(50)% for 10 seconds, and applies the 'Xilu-Xilu' debuff to all enemies for 4 seconds if conditions are met.
4604.skillDesc2:
When equipping 2 or more Spray-type weapons, using this weapon for the first time grants one of the following bonuses: 

1. Increases Crit Rate by 200(250)% and Crit Damage by 250(300)%; 
2. Increases Weapon ATK by 450(600)%; 
3. Increases Attack Speed by 270(350)%; 
4. Increases All Damage by 800(1000)% and increases Max Ammo by 20%.

"After Xilu done choosing, Xilu will defeats all normal enemies and normal elites on screen, and restores 100% HP and Shield. Xilu will help you choose the most useful bonus as possible"

4818.name: Sinister Wave
4818.skillDesc1: When continuously using this weapon, gain 1 stack of [Incinerating Charge] every 0.25 seconds. Each stack increases this weapon's Critical Chance by 65(115)%, Attack Range by 20%, and inflicts additional Fire DMG equal to 20% of the weapon's ATK per hit. Max 6 stacks. When this weapon hits an enemy, increases the DMG they receive by 60(80)% for 4 seconds
4818.skillDesc2: When [Incinerating Charge] stacks exceed 3, increases the DMG dealt by this weapon by 180(300)%. When switching to another weapon, consumes all [Incinerating Charge] stacks; each stack deals 1 area of Fire DMG equal to 1000(1420)% of weapon ATK to all enemies on the field, and inflicts the Burn state on them, dealing Fire DMG equal to 100% of weapon ATK every second for 5 seconds.
4818.skillDesc3: When equipped only with Melee or Spray-type weapons, gain 3 stacks of [Incinerating Charge] upon entering a stage, and each stack of [Incinerating Charge] additionally increases this weapon's DMG dealt by 50(80)%.
4818.skillDesc4: For 9(12) seconds after Player using Pet Ultimate Skill or using Character's Skill, holding this weapon will quickly gain [Incinerating Charge] stacks. This effect can trigger up to 6 times per stage.
4818.passiveDesc: Increases all melee weapon Attack Speed by 10%. After attacking 5 times consecutively, increases all melee weapon Critical Rate by 10%.
